versions.content: The “VIN” of a vehicle identification response/vehicle announcement message shall be derived by calling Dcm_GetVin. If Dcm_GetVin returns E_OK, the 17 Bytes in the pointer shall be used, if the callback returns E_NOT_OK the 17 Bytes shall be filled with the configured DoIPVinInvalidityPattern with “Further Action Required” field set to 0x00 and VIN/GID sync. Status field set to 0x10 if (DoIPUseVehicleIdentificationSyncStatus) is set to true.
